author: Hermes
options: Part-D: General Engineering (Computer Science and IT)
question: According to the SSC JE 2026 notice, which Paper-I/Paper-II part must a JE (Electrical) candidate attempt?
solution: The notice scheme lists Part-A for Civil, Part-B General Engineering (Electrical) for Electrical posts, and Part-C for Mechanical; the Electrical candidate attempts Part-B. Source checked: https://ssc.gov.in/api/attachment/uploads/masterData/NoticeBoards/Notice_of_adv_je_2026.pdf
subject: Exam pattern
